verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a mobile git client with diff viewing, hunk staging, image comparison and a cross-branch commit graph, but nothing documents opening, viewing, commenting on or approving pull requests. Item docs-19 mentions creating unspecified "these" for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab, which neither clearly refers to pull requests nor describes reviewing them. Inspecting branch diffs locally is an adjacent workaround, not PR review.
